convert_efficientloftr_checkpoint: convert an EfficientLoFTR PyTorch checkpoint to HuggingFace Transformers format
verify_model_outputs: verify the converted EfficientLoFTR model outputs match expected tensor shapes and scores
convert_old_keys_to_new_keys: convert old checkpoint key names to new HuggingFace key names using regex mappings
write_image_processor: write an EfficientLoFTR image processor configuration to a local directory or push to hub
save_efficientloftr_model: save a converted EfficientLoFTR model to a local directory with config and weights
